newsitem.title: UK: BT down on ADR trade, active on huge deal.
newsitem.headline: BT down on ADR trade, active on huge deal.

text.p: Shares in British Telecommunications Plc fell on Tuesday in heavy volume as a late ADR trade in the U.S. and a broker-to-broker trade in London both made their impact on the stock.
The shares fell 9p to 415p by 1345 GMT as volume exceeded 50 million.
Traders said BT's share price was dragged lower on the back of a late sell order in its ADRs in the U.S. overnight.
"There was a large-size order in the States and someone is unwinding that position," one dealer said. "That's what the problem was this morning."
Meanwhile, at midday in London a broker-to-broker trade of 35.8 million shares at a price of 416p was executed.
"It could well have been a dividend or options type trade, but it's impossible to tell," another dealer said.
